messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Serbian (Latin script), guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Serbian (Latin script) line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
Kad sam ga video u velikoj pustinji, Smiluj se meni vrištih njemu, Šta god da si ili senka ili pravi čovek!

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Alignment Table (Step 3)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation | Status | |-------------|-----------------------|----------------------|------------------|--------| | Quando | temporal conjunction “when” | Kad | “when” | OK | | vidi | verb, past “saw” | video | “saw” | OK | | costui | demonstrative pronoun “him” | ga | “him” | OK | | nel | preposition “in” | u | “in” | OK | | gran | adjective “great” | velikoj | “great” (locative) | OK | | diserto | noun “desert” | pustinji | “desert” (locative) | OK | | Miserere | imperative “have pity” | Smiluj se | “have pity” | OK | | di | preposition “on” | meni | “to me” (wrong case) | **WRONG** | | me | pronoun “me” | — | — | **MISSING** | | gridai | verb, past “cried / shouted” | vrištih | “shouted” | OK | | a | preposition “to” | — | — | **MISSING** | | lui | pronoun “him” | njemu | “to him” | OK | | qual | relative pronoun “whatever” | Šta | “what” | OK | | che | relative particle (connects *qual* with clause) | — | — | **UNNECESSARY** | | tu | pronoun “you” (2nd sg) | — | — | **MISSING** | | sii | verb “be” (subjunctive) | si | “are” | OK | | od | conjunction “or” (first) | ili | “or” | OK | | ombra | noun “shade” | senka | “shade” | OK | | od | conjunction “or” (second) | ili | “or” | OK | | omo | noun “man” | čovek | “man” | OK | | certo | adjective “certain / real” | pravi | “real” | OK |
---
### Items to Address
- **MISSING**: *me*, *a*, *tu* – these source elements have no counterpart in the Serbian output. - **WRONG**: *di* rendered as **meni** (dative) instead of the required prepositional phrase **na mene** (accusative with “on”). - **UNNECESSARY**: *che* – the relative particle is not needed in Serbian and was omitted, which is acceptable; it is flagged only to note that the source element does not map to any target word.
No additional **GRAMMAR** errors were detected beyond the case mistake noted for *di*.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Serbian (Latin script) script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Serbian (Latin script) text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- **Line 64** - Original: Kad sam ga video u velikoj pustinji, - Issue: none - Corrected: Kad sam ga video u velikoj pustinji,
- **Line 65** - Original: Smiluj se meni vrištih njemu, - Issue: WRONG – “meni” should be “na mene” to render “on me”; missing preposition “di”. - Corrected: Smiluj se na mene vrištih njemu,
- **Line 66** - Original: Šta god da si ili senka ili pravi čovek! - Issue: none - Corrected: Šta god da si ili senka ili pravi čovek!
